variants.soft_coordinate: full-softmax probability with the fixed expert coordinate system; it does not read stored top-4 IDs but still retains expert identity
variants.actual_support: Jaccard recurrence of the actually selected top-4 expert IDs
variants.selected_weight: weighted Jaccard recurrence of actual IDs and selected combine probabilities
variants.rank_shape: sort all 32 probabilities at every position; retains probability shape but removes expert identity
variants.reconstructed_support: top-4 support deterministically reconstructed from float16 full-softmax probabilities
variants.tie_resolved_support: actual top-4 support, evaluated only when both compared positions have strictly separated fourth and fifth probabilities
variants.chunk_relabel_soft: apply a different deterministic permutation of all 32 expert coordinates to every replan before soft recurrence
variants.chunk_relabel_support: apply the same per-replan permutation to selected IDs before support recurrence

scoring.cell_aggregation: 75th percentile over 2 layer groups x 3 action-token groups
scoring.self_baseline: for lag k, subtract the median at queries k through k+2
scoring.healthy_calibration: upper empirical CDF from source-run successful healthy-reference episodes, stratified by query bin
scoring.temporal_persistence: second-highest score among current and previous two consecutive replans

tie_filter.criterion: float16 p_(4) > p_(5) at both compared positions

runtime_excluded_inputs: task identity as a detector feature
